scope: Read-only transport latency review; this evidence file is the only output written for this subtask. No service, tunnel, Viewer, source, spec or plan changes.

measurementBoundaries.viewerBusinessRtt: Viewer-local pending send to receipt/handling of business ACK; includes endpoint scheduling and execution, not just network.
measurementBoundaries.hostAdapterAwait: Host-local monotonic adapter await from structured host_input_result.meta.localExecuteMs, including adapter queue wait. Wire hostExecuteMs is deliberately not used.
measurementBoundaries.residual: viewerBusinessRttMs minus matched structured hostAdapterAwaitMs. Remaining components include Viewer scheduling/transport queues, forward and return network, Signal scheduling/forwarding for Socket, Host ingress scheduling before the timed adapter, and ACK handling. It is NOT pure network latency or a one-way delay.
measurementBoundaries.population: Four selected event-level matches, not a random sample or p50/p95 population estimate. Duplicate diagnostic uploads are not separate inputs.
measurementBoundaries.clockPolicy: Only local durations are subtracted. No RTT/2 one-way estimate and no Viewer-minus-Host timestamp estimate is used for input residuals.

ackAndTimingPaths.ackPath: Host reliable ordered input DataChannel to Viewer
ackAndTimingPaths.ordering: Current Host enqueues the business ACK before adding this input to the next frame timing. Normal same-channel ordered delivery protects the ACK-before-timing order. input-move ingress is unordered but its ACK still returns on the reliable input channel.

ackAndTimingPaths.inputPath: Socket.IO input/reset/fallback to Signal then Host
ackAndTimingPaths.ackPath: Host Socket.IO to Signal then Viewer; public Viewer may traverse Cloudflare
ackAndTimingPaths.timingPath: Host reliable input DataChannel to Viewer, if a DC remains active
ackAndTimingPaths.raceCondition: Independent paths have no cross-transport delivery ordering. A slower Socket ACK can be overtaken by frame_timing over DC even on the current Host. Keyboard and mouse reset prefer Socket while DC can remain open.

offlineFrameTimingRace.method: Node vm evaluated the repository latency-monitor.js with fake local monotonic/wall clocks; no browser or network. recordInputSend at 100ms; schemaVersion 2 frame_timing for that fixture at 120ms; input_ack at 300ms; no video-frame callback.
offlineFrameTimingRace.cause: onFrameTiming consumes input pending without checking legacy Host capability; visualFeedback is timing-message receipt, not paint. Host sends frame_timing before VideoStreamTrack.recv returns, before actual encoding and presentation.

offlineTunnelAckClockPreference.method: Extracted the real TunnelRelayStreamer.ack method from host.py using Python AST, with fake Host monotonic clock and in-flight frame. No Host initialization, capture, network or service invocation.
offlineTunnelAckClockPreference.cause: Host prefers client latencyMs when supplied. Viewer computes this as Date.now minus Host frame timestamp; independent wall-clock offset contaminates both UI and feedback. This client value also excludes the ACK return leg.
offlineTunnelAckClockPreference.productionMetricCaveat: TUNNEL_RELAY_STATS avg_ack_ms is not guaranteed to be Host-local round-trip or pure network latency.

previous0705msVerification.boundary: The 0.705ms claim is a real structured Host adapter-await duration, not wire hostExecuteMs, network RTT, or visible native effect time.

requirements.constraint: Separate Viewer local pending RTT, Host adapter await and visual feedback; do not mix timing with business ACK RTT or infer cross-machine one-way latency.
Independent business ACK; local timing domains; no cross-machine wall-clock subtraction.
ACK p95 <=150ms and Host event-loop p95 <=50ms apply to the specified local-login real-TURN acceptance scenario, not an unconditional public-path SLA.

redaction.correlation: Only bounded SHA-256 prefixes already present in redacted production observations; source file paths retained for verification.

limitations: Log line numbers may change with rotation; match timestamp, event and inputIdHash as well.
No new production Viewer, active input, packet capture, stress test or live service change was performed.
Signal does not record a complete input/ACK ingress-egress timing chain; exact one-way network and browser scheduling portions remain unknown.
